gameDescriptionHtml: Every ninja, from the mythical tricksters of old to the covert operatives of the modern day, began as a student. Today, those students train at secret schools throughout Japan, from converted old castles to normal-looking high schools. Join the finest among equals at Hanzo National Academy, or the tough-as-nails survivors of Hebijo Clandestine Girls’ Academy, as they risk their young lives (and their nicest outfits!) for honor, family, and friends.
